items.title: defaults vs all-off vs drawExec=off vs rigMeshAlias=on at ultra - hbbench first turn / still / moving / tour, fresh profile per arm-rep
items.boxMode: 1070, MODE T, uncapped, fresh profile per arm-rep (hbbench does both). OWNER-RUN.
recipe: Snapshot server as for P0 (hb-mksnap.sh -> serve.py on :8766 with --check green), then:
items.reads: summary.json per arm-rep: firstTurn / still / moving / tour fps, p99, low1, jank, draws; errs must be 0.
decisionRules: Written 2026-10-26 BEFORE the run. Spread = max - min of an arm's own reps, per measure.
Keep the defaults iff rc-defaults >= rc-alloff - spread(rc-alloff) on still, moving AND tour fps. Expected [D]: +2-3 ms/frame of main thread, i.e. ~45 -> ~50 fps where the main thread is the limit.

If rc-defaults < rc-alloff - spread on any measure: stop, keep the batch's numbers, and bisect by lane with one-off arms (rustParticles=off, rustRig=off, rustCull=off, rustAnimScenery=off, drawExec=off, hot*=off) before changing any default.
drawExec: if rc-noexec > rc-defaults + spread(rc-defaults) on still or moving fps, flip drawExec (and drawExecRigs) back to default OFF.
rigMeshAlias (owner decision, not a rule): report rc-alias vs rc-defaults; the node estimate is 0.05-0.10 ms/frame.
items.result: 2026-10-30: NOT DECIDED. Reps 1-3 (rep 1 in $RC/bench2, reps 2-3 in $RC/bench3, all 8 v2 arms, frozen rep-1 snapshot) are all INVALID under rule V (hbreport bench, $RC/bench3/report-pooled.txt): idle 0 s in every box sample, Seagate Toolkit at ~1 core (back since the 11:40 reboot), the owner's Chrome at 1-2 cores in 4 reps, gpu3d_other 6-18% in 4 reps.
